featured_reviews.name: giriraj bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Ramesh Hardware Store and was thoroughly impressed. The **quality** of their products is top-notch. I found exactly what I needed for my home repair project, and everything felt sturdy and well-made.

The **prices** are also very reasonable. I compared a few items with other stores, and Ramesh Hardware offered a better deal without sacrificing quality.

The **collection** is outstanding. They have a huge variety of tools, materials, and supplies. I was able to find everything on my list in one place, which saved me a lot of time and hassle.

Finally, the **service** was excellent. The staff was friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. They guided me to the right aisles and even offered some useful tips for my project. It's refreshing to get such personalized service.

Overall, Ramesh Hardware Store is a fantastic find. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for quality products, great prices, and exceptional service. I'll definitely be back for all my future hardware needs.

featured_reviews.name: Irshad Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text: Avoid buying from this vendor; they charge exorbitant prices. For instance, a 6mm tube that costs ₹12 per meter in the market is sold here for ₹25 per meter. Similarly, a 10mm tube priced at ₹34 per meter is charged at ₹70 per meter, and a T-connector costing ₹12 is sold for ₹20. When confronted about the prices, they'll claim their products are of better quality. Based on personal experience, this vendor, being Gujarati, tends to charge double the market price.

featured_reviews.name: I S
featured_reviews.review_text: I have noticed that this hardware shop does not have fixed prices. Every time I buy the same product, the price changes. The first time, they might offer a lower rate than other shops to attract customers, but on the next visit, they increase the price significantly to make up for it. This is a tricky way of doing business. Be sure to check prices at other shops before purchasing. The owner, Nirmal, seems to adjust rates based on what he feels like charging. Be cautious and compare prices elsewhere before buying!
